# ExDevX

> Independent digital engineering studio based in Maharashtra, India. We design and build web platforms, mobile apps, automation systems, and production AI integrations.

## Core Capabilities
- Web Platforms: Modern, accessible web applications and marketing platforms built with TypeScript, React, Next.js, and Node.js.
- Mobile Applications: Cross-platform iOS and Android apps engineered with React Native, Expo, and native modules.
- Automation Systems: Workflow automations, scraping engines, background workers, and headless integration pipelines.
- AI Integration: Production AI applications powered by Google Gemini, LLM agents, and structured schema outputs.

## Key Projects & Case Studies
- ConfigShell (https://configshell.antideploy.com/): Interactive Linux distribution package and environment configuration generator.
- Shri Shivaji New Law College (https://ssnlc.in): High-traffic academic portal and admissions system.
- KisanPool (https://kisanpool.in): Agricultural produce pooling and price discovery platform.
- PerpWise AI (https://perpwise.ai): Real-time derivatives analytics engine with risk scoring.
